Question: Assalamaikum Mufti Sahab, My younger brother name is Minhaj Rashid. He had a cardiac arrest at Jully,07. Since then he lost his short term memory. Could you please tell me a Dua, which will help him to get back his memory Insha? Answer ID: 11598 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 470/337=L/1430) Ask your brother to recite ya aleem ( یا علیم ) daily 150 times anytime. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
